desc: Home road for gates an expedition used to hold alone (docs/GARDEN.md, 'Gates for a player who never extracts'). Progress.stat(k) in base mode is the larger of the real stat and a home stat divided by `per`, so every challenge, shop requirement and farm milestone that counts an expedition stat can also be met in the garden. Only existing home stats are used (harvested, hatched, built, fb_built, max_trust). Nothing is re-locked after an expedition: the real stat still counts.

extracts.note: one made-it-out run about 5 harvests; Old Hand (5 runs) = 25, Island Legend (15) = 75

matches.note: first expedition = first hatch (egg ripens in 10 minutes)

bosses.note: first boss = a Boki bonded to 60 trust (care streak: feed, pet, play)

knocks.note: 5 knocks = 3 lot buildings (a fresh Boki starts at trust 35, so no bond road)
